title: Add the published T740 histogram and compare its root with the selected kappa
body:
## Summary
- The published histogram `{1:16417896, 2:4835160, 3:1540174, 4:679321, 5:143992, 6:3, 8:53280, 48:283185}` has 23,953,011 children and rank mass 48,165,120.
- The stated schedule is 740 replicas, `740 · 9 = 6,660` calls, and `6,660 · 408 = 2,717,280` helper roles.
- The conditional root `0.001730006549538841847005 − 10^(−46) − 10^(−70)` is greater than `0.00173` and greater than the selected kappa. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/t740-histogram-mass/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/t740-histogram-mass/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t740-histogram-mass`
- [ ] Maintainer replay on canonical main
